questions.question: How can you prevent yourself from becoming an aggressive driver?

options.text: Stay calm and focus on driving.
Drive faster than the posted speed limit.
Drive very close behind the car in front of you.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stay calm and focus on driving.
questions.explanation: To avoid becoming an aggressive driver, stay calm and focus on your driving. Don't take other drivers' actions personally. Leave plenty of time for your trip, follow the speed limit, and be patient with other drivers.

questions.question: When are seat belts most effective?

options.text: Only for the driver.
Only for passengers on long trips.
Only for all passengers on expressways.
For all passengers every time the car is driven.

questions.correctAnswerText: For all passengers every time the car is driven.
questions.explanation: Everyone in a car should wear a seat belt every time you drive. If a person is not wearing a seat belt during a crash, they can fly around inside the car and hurt other people.

questions.question: What is the only way to lower your blood alcohol concentration (BAC)?

options.text: Drink coffee.
Exercise.
Wait for your body to process the alcohol over time.
Take a cold shower.

questions.correctAnswerText: Wait for your body to process the alcohol over time.
questions.explanation: Your body needs time to get rid of alcohol. Coffee, exercise, and cold showers cannot lower your BAC or reduce alcohol's effects. They may keep you awake, but they do not change your BAC or make you sober.

questions.question: Why should you not follow other cars too closely?

options.text: You may not see the road between the cars.
You may not have time to stop if the car ahead suddenly slows or stops.
You may not see the car's turn signals.
You may not see the car's brake lights.

questions.correctAnswerText: You may not have time to stop if the car ahead suddenly slows or stops.
questions.explanation: If you follow too closely and the car in front of you suddenly slows or stops, you may not have enough time to stop and avoid hitting it.

questions.question: What do double solid yellow lines in the middle of the road mean?

options.text: Railroad crossing ahead.
Pedestrian crossing ahead.
No passing is allowed from either direction.
Passing is allowed from either direction.

questions.correctAnswerText: No passing is allowed from either direction.
questions.explanation: Double solid yellow lines mean you cannot pass in either direction. You can only cross these lines to turn left or to safely pass pedestrians, cyclists, or scooter and skateboard riders when the other lane is clear.

questions.question: When do blind persons have the legal right-of-way when crossing the street?

options.text: When wearing light-colored clothing.
When being led by a guide dog or using a white or metallic cane.
When being helped by another person.
When wearing dark-colored glasses.

questions.correctAnswerText: When being led by a guide dog or using a white or metallic cane.
questions.explanation: Blind pedestrians using a guide dog or white or metallic cane have the right-of-way at any crosswalk, even if traffic signals or other rules say otherwise.

questions.question: What does this symbol mean?

options.text: Dangerous intersections ahead.
Slow-moving vehicle.
Yield sign.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow-moving vehicle.
questions.explanation: An orange triangle on the back of a vehicle shows it moves slowly. You may see this on construction equipment, farm vehicles, or horse-drawn wagons. It looks orange during the day and appears red at night.

questions.question: Which statement about large trucks is true?

options.text: They need more distance to stop than passenger cars.
They all have air brakes that let them stop quickly.
They are easier to steer than passenger cars.

questions.correctAnswerText: They need more distance to stop than passenger cars.
questions.explanation: Large trucks need more distance to stop than cars traveling at the same speed. A car going 55 mph can stop in about 400 feet. A large truck at the same speed needs almost 800 feet to stop.

questions.question: What should you do if you feel tired while driving?

options.text: Drive faster to get to your destination more quickly.
Turn up your radio volume.
Find a safe place to park and take a short nap.

questions.correctAnswerText: Find a safe place to park and take a short nap.
questions.explanation: Watch for signs of fatigue while driving. You are too tired if you struggle to keep your eyes open, drift from your lane, or turn up the radio to stay awake. If you notice these signs, park in a safe place to rest and take a short nap.

questions.question: What does a chemical test measure?

options.text: Reaction time.
Blood alcohol content.
Vision.
Driving ability.

questions.correctAnswerText: Blood alcohol content.
questions.explanation: A chemical test measures blood alcohol content (BAC). You can test breath, blood, urine, or saliva. However, a chemical test is not always needed to prove someone was intoxicated. A police officer's observations about your driving, appearance, and behavior may be enough to convict you, even without a chemical test.

questions.question: Before changing lanes or passing another vehicle, you should:

options.text: Check your blind spots and mirrors.
Signal your intention before changing lanes.
All of the above.

questions.correctAnswerText: All of the above.
questions.explanation: Always signal before changing lanes. Always check your mirrors and look over your shoulder to check your blind spot before moving left or right.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Continue at your current speed.
You must stop ahead.
Speeding is not allowed.
There is a traffic signal ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a traffic signal ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a traffic signal is coming up ahead.

questions.question: Using a hand-held cell phone while driving:

options.text: Is safer than using a hands-free cell phone.
May only be done by teenage drivers.
Is illegal.
Is recommended.

questions.correctAnswerText: Is illegal.
questions.explanation: It is against the law in New York to use a hand-held cell phone while driving. You will get a fine and points on your license if you do.

questions.question: Distracted driving can be caused by:

options.text: Eating, drinking, or smoking.
Talking or texting on a cell phone.
Changing a radio station or CD.
All of the above.

questions.correctAnswerText: All of the above.
questions.explanation: Drivers need to focus completely on driving. Any other activity takes attention away from the road and is dangerous.

questions.question: Which of the following signs is rectangular?

options.text: School crossing sign
Railroad crossing sign
Stop sign
Speed limit sign

questions.correctAnswerText: Speed limit sign
questions.explanation: Speed limit signs are white rectangles with black text. They tell you about speed limits and other driving rules.

questions.question: If you see pedestrians in a crosswalk ahead, what should you do?

options.text: Continue ahead. You have the right-of-way.
Wait for the pedestrians to cross the street.
Go around the pedestrians on the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Wait for the pedestrians to cross the street.
questions.explanation: Pedestrians in a crosswalk have the right-of-way. You must wait for them to finish crossing before you proceed.

questions.question: Only ____ can reduce blood alcohol content and alcohol's effects on the body.

options.text: Drinking caffeine
Eating foods high in fat
Time

questions.correctAnswerText: Time
questions.explanation: Only time can remove alcohol from your body and reduce its effects.

questions.question: What happens when you drink alcohol while taking prescription or over-the-counter medicine?

options.text: The medicine reduces the effect of the alcohol.
The alcohol helps the medicine cure a cold.
The combination could multiply the effects of both.
There is no effect because they are different substances.

questions.correctAnswerText: The combination could multiply the effects of both.
questions.explanation: Mixing alcohol with other drugs can make both more dangerous. For example, one drink with cold medicine could affect you like several drinks would alone.

questions.question: If a train is coming and could be a danger, you must:

options.text: Slow down and proceed with caution.
Not cross the tracks until the train has completely passed.
Cross the tracks at your own risk.
Find an alternative route across the tracks.

questions.correctAnswerText: Not cross the tracks until the train has completely passed.
questions.explanation: Look and listen for trains before crossing any railroad tracks. If a train is coming and could be dangerous, do not cross. This is true even if there are no signals or the signals are not working.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Narrow bridge ahead.
A lane is ending or the road is narrowing ahead.
Industrial area.
Freeway on-ramp ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: A lane is ending or the road is narrowing ahead.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on yellow. This sign warns you that the right lane is ending or the road is getting narrower ahead.
